title: telemetry.dev — Observability for AI and LLM apps
excerpt: Trace every model call, tool step, and retrieval with tokens, cost, latency, and errors in one place. OpenTelemetry-native. First trace in five minutes.
content_html:
When something breaks, you'll know why

One slow request or a month of spend: the traces and metrics to answer it, fast.

Integrations

Any framework. Any language. One endpoint.

However you added AI to your app, you can send its OTLP traces here. We normalize supported fields into a consistent view of spans, tokens, and cost.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is telemetry.dev?

telemetry.dev is an observability platform for AI and LLM apps. It captures each instrumented request or agent run as an OpenTelemetry trace, with model calls, tool steps, and retrievals represented as spans. Tokens, cost, latency, and errors help you debug failures and track spend across models, providers, and environments.

How do I start sending traces?

Drop in our SDK, or point any OpenTelemetry exporter at our endpoint. Add your project API key and your first trace shows up in about five minutes.

Which frameworks and languages are supported?

TypeScript and Python have first-party SDKs, and the Vercel AI SDK has a drop-in integration. Anything else that emits standard OTLP over HTTP — LangChain, OpenLLMetry-instrumented apps, or your own OpenTelemetry setup — works through the same endpoint. More drop-in integrations are on the way.

How is cost calculated?

Cost is computed server-side from token usage reported for each call — including input, output, cached, and reasoning tokens — using current pricing for 8,600+ model identifiers. You can supply an explicit cost per span when needed.

Is the free plan actually free?

Yes, with no credit card. You get 10,000 ingestion units a month — one per span, log record, or metric data point — plus 7-day retention, one project, and two seats, free for as long as you want. Upgrade only when your volume outgrows it.

Can I keep prompts and completions out of storage?

Yes. Input and output capture is a per-environment switch, so you can store full prompts in development and none in production. Secrets like API keys are redacted at ingest, and you can add custom redaction patterns per project.

Your first trace is five minutes away

Install one package, add an API key, send a request. That's the whole setup.

Free plan includes 10,000 ingestion units a month — one per span, log record, or metric data point. No credit card required.

常见问题解答

What is telemetry.dev?

telemetry.dev 是一个用于 AI 和 LLM 应用程序的可观察平台。 It captures each instrumented request or agent run as an OpenTelemetry trace, with model calls, tool steps, and retrievals represented as spans. Tokens, cost, latency, and errors help you debug failures and track spend across models, providers, and environments.

How do I start sending traces?

放入我们的 SDK，或将任何 OpenTelemetry 导出器指向我们的端点。 添加您的项目 API 密钥，您的第一个跟踪将在大约五分钟内显示。

Which frameworks and languages are supported?

TypeScript 和 Python 具有第一方 SDK，Vercel AI SDK 具有直接集成。 通过 HTTP 发出标准 OTLP 的任何其他内容（LangChain、OpenLLMetry 仪表化应用程序或您自己的 OpenTelemetry 设置）都通过相同的端点工作。 更多的直接集成正在进行中。

How is cost calculated?

Cost is computed server-side from token usage reported for each call — including input, output, cached, and reasoning tokens — using current pricing for 8,600+ model identifiers. You can supply an explicit cost per span when needed.

Is the free plan actually free?

是的，没有信用卡。 You get 10,000 ingestion units a month — one per span, log record, or metric data point — plus 7-day retention, one project, and two seats, free for as long as you want. 仅当您的卷容量超出时才升级。

Can I keep prompts and completions out of storage?

是的。 输入和输出捕获是每个环境的开关，因此您可以在开发中存储完整的提示，而在生产中则不存储任何提示。 像 API 密钥这样的秘密会在摄取时进行编辑，您可以为每个项目添加自定义编辑模式。

您的第一条踪迹距离您还有五分钟路程

安装一个软件包，添加 API 密钥，发送请求。 这就是整个设置。

Free plan includes 10,000 ingestion units a month — one per span, log record, or metric data point. 无需信用卡。
